title: Lingguang ecosystem expands further! Six new connectors added, including WeChat ClawBot, QQ bot, and Luckin Coffee
excerpt: On November 12, Lingguang's open ecosystem expanded again, adding support for six new connectors: WeChat ClawBot, QQ Bot, Luckin Coffee, Youdao Cloud Notes, Tic
content_html:
On November 12, Lingguang's open ecosystem expanded again, adding support for six new connectors: WeChat ClawBot, QQ Bot, Luckin Coffee, Youdao Cloud Notes, TickTick, and Tencent News. Connectors broaden the boundaries of Lingguang's capabilities. This expansion allows Lingguang's services to cover high-frequency scenarios such as instant messaging, knowledge management, and task collaboration, bringing the number of external connected services to 47.

After this ecosystem expansion, Lingguang connects to some WeChat and QQ functions through the WeChat ClawBot and QQ Bot connectors. Users can send tasks and receive replies in WeChat private chats, and can also check message history and delivery status. The QQ Bot connector supports private chat and group chat message processing, proactive notifications, and scheduled message push after confirmation. For example, in a QQ group, users only need to say, "Push today's reminder to the group at 9 a.m. every day," and the connector can configure the corresponding task.

The Youdao Cloud Notes and TickTick connectors allow Lingguang to significantly improve knowledge management and efficiency. Users can search, read, and manage content in Youdao Cloud Notes through natural language, or clip a web page to notes with one click. They can also directly ask Lingguang to create, update, and complete tasks in TickTick, without repeatedly switching apps, making to-do management easier.

The next stage of AI competition is not only a competition of model capabilities, but also a competition of ecosystem connectivity and scenario implementation capabilities.

Lingguang's continuous expansion of its connector ecosystem is precisely aimed at breaking down the boundaries between AI and external applications, enabling more tools and services to be understood, invoked, and coordinated by AI. From intelligence in a single application to cross-application, cross-scenario capability collaboration, Lingguang is building a continuously growing AI application ecosystem, enabling AI to gradually evolve from a standalone intelligent tool into a personal AI assistant that connects digital life and services and helps you manage things well.

It is understood that Lingguang is a personal AI assistant under Ant Group. It launched on November 18, 2025, and surpassed 2 million users in its first week. On October 27, 2026, Lingguang 2.0 was officially released, pushing AI assistants from "task executors" to "affairs managers." Since its release, it has helped users manage over 3 million affairs. Currently, Lingguang has surpassed 20 million users.
